# Test and release artifacts

**Current release:** [v1.2](https://github.com/PhaedrusXY/Arcane_Syntax/releases/tag/v1.2). The downloadable artifact is exactly **`arcane_syntax_unified-1.2.jar`**, with embedded mod version **1.2**. Its output directory is generated by `tools/patch_focus_layout.py` as `dist/1.2/`; the GitHub release hosts the JAR.

**Naming convention:** Use two-part `X.Y` versions and the single canonical filename `arcane_syntax_unified-X.Y.jar`. Release details go in GitHub release notes and CHANGELOG.md, not the filename.

**Historical artifacts:** The prior GitHub `0.2.x` candidates (including `v0.2.2`) were development releases and are preserved for reproducibility. They are superseded by **1.2**. Repackaging changes the internal version as well as the name; do not use a renamed 0.2.2 binary as a 1.2 upload.

The `0.2.1/` ZIP is the unchanged incremental test update supplied for the existing Eldritch Aeons 0.2.0 focus migration. It is not a complete modpack or a validated standalone release. The same overlay is expanded under `deployment/0.2.1/`.

See the root README and `docs/TESTING_STATUS.md` for later maintainer reports. The ZIP's internal readme/validation documents reflect its original build-time status. No new JAR was built during repository preparation.
